rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a Day-5 expanded blastocyst and acknowledges ICM/TE assessment limits, but it over-interprets image-specific features like a focal opening/collapse and questions the reported BA ICM without strong visual basis.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, semen quality, endometrial thickness, and lack of prior IVF history into prognosis and transfer counseling.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis; only minor issue is somewhat speculative morphology driving parts of the estimate.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET and not routinely recommending PGT-A at age 20; some suggestions are more discretionary than guideline-driven.
Provides practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including uterine evaluation and endometriosis-focused considerations, though some advice remains somewhat general.
